teacher.target: per-frame robust affine parameters mapping DA V2 dense depth to Metric3D dense depth
teacher.heldout_teacher_access: forbidden to head fitting and prediction; retained only as separately reported oracle comparator

student.input: frozen DA V2 Metric Hypersim ViT-S layer-11 CLS token
student.head: two-output standardized ridge regression predicting global slope a and offset b
student.feature_standardization: train-fold mean and population standard deviation only; zero std replaced by one

evaluation.split: four-fold leave-one-sequence-out; no frame-level random split
evaluation.training_truth: Metric3D teacher affine labels only; registered RGB-D sensor depth forbidden
evaluation.evaluation_truth: registered RGB-D sensor-derived clearance proxy opened only after fold predictions

stop_rules: Do not search layer, feature pooling, ridge, head family, target, seed, fold, threshold, or operating point after outcomes are read.
Do not use registered RGB-D sensor truth in teacher-label construction, feature normalization, fitting, or model selection.
A student matching Metric3D does not establish metric truth; promotion still requires fresh real RGB-D or ranging validation.
